artworks.title: The Crossing of the Red Sea
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene on a body of water. A chariot, pulled by horses, is struggling in crashing waves. A figure in regal attire is shown being thrown from the chariot, with the horses also depicted in distress. Spears are visible in the background, and there are fallen figures in the foreground. The illustration is intricate and detailed, emphasizing movement.

artworks.title: Moses and Aaron before the Pharoah
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene in an ancient architectural setting. The scene features a central figure seated on a throne surrounded by various individuals engaged in a discussion or presentation. The seated figure wears a crown and is situated under a draped canopy. The individuals around the throne are dressed in robes, each making animated gestures. In front of the throne, on the floor, are a small dog and two snakes. The background shows an open architectural archway with buildings visible, and the floor is checkered with a detailed pattern. This composition emphasizes the centrality and authority of the seated figure, while the others present contribute to the narrative.

artworks.title: The Invasion of the Frogs
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This image depicts an ancient scene with architectural elements, several figures, and animals. The scene features a group of figures gathered around a table under a classical portico, with pillars and drapery. In the foreground, frogs are depicted entering from an open archway. Interior and exterior elements are detailed, showing dynamic movement and interaction. The background shows more figures interacting with animals. Architectural details such as columns, arches, and draped fabric add depth and perspective to the setting.

artworks.title: Preparation for the Passover
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group gathered around a table preparing a meal indoors. Outside, an ominous scene unfolds. The figures are clad in ancient attire and appear engaged in the preparation of a feast. A lamb is placed on the table. The interior is marked by a round window through which light enters. Outside, an angel wields a sword over lifeless figures on the street. Inside, a person applies blood to the doorpost with a bunch of hyssop. A dog stands near the group. The architectural elements include arches and a spire.

artworks.title: The Exodus from Egypt
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of people moving across a landscape with their belongings and animals. The scene shows individuals with burdens on their backs, suggesting migration. In the foreground, a seated figure handles a basket while a young child is nearby. Various figures are transporting items like pots, bundles, and livestock, indicating departure or exodus. In the background, a large crowd further emphasizes the scale of movement, with hills or mountains in the distance. Animals such as a small dog and cattle are visible among the crowd, and the drawing features detailed poses and expressions conveying action and purpose.

artworks.title: Envy
artworks.artist: attributed to Jacob Matham, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure with snake-like hair, holding a serpent and an apple, accompanied by a dog. The figure is shown in a dynamic pose, with one foot lifted. In one hand, they hold an apple, and in the other hand, they hold a serpent. A dog stands near the figure. The background features a semi-abstract landscape with rolling hills and sparse vegetation. The image is detailed, with fine lines illustrating muscle definition and fabric texture.

artworks.title: The Unmerciful Servant Brought before the King
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals in an ancient architectural interior. The central figure sits on a throne, holding an item that may be a scepter. One individual kneels before them, restrained by others. The setting includes ornate architectural elements like columns and drapery. The drawing features detailed lines and hatching, giving depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Sacrifice of Isaac
artworks.artist: Andreas Altomonte, after David Teniers the Younger
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two figures: an older man and a young boy. The man, with a long beard and possibly a bald head, is kneeling on the ground, guiding the boy who stands in front of him. They both wear textured historic or biblical garments, with the man's featuring fur accents and the boy's having a looser fit. In front of them is a stone altar with a sacrificed ram on it, emitting smoke. Burning wood surrounds the altar. In the background, a bare-branched tree looms overhead, and in the distance, a rural landscape with a building and several smaller figures is visible. The ground is covered in grass, with tools like scissors and sticks placed nearby.

artworks.title: Triumphal Arch for Henry II
artworks.artist: Johann Ulrich Kraus, after Peter Schubert von Ehrenberg
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade or altar. The drawing features a detailed structure with classical architectural elements such as columns and arches. Decorative elements like swirling patterns, sculptural figures, and scenes within cartouches adorn the structure. At the top, a figure with angels is depicted with rays emanating behind them. Below, panels and scenes depict historical, mythological, or religious tales. An entryway in the center provides a glimpse of a distant architectural scene. The design reflects the grandiosity of Baroque architecture with dramatic detail and dynamic forms.

artworks.title: Triumphal Arch for Lotharius II
artworks.artist: Christian Engelbrecht and Johann Andreas Pfeffel, after Peter Schubert von Ehrenberg
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure with classical elements and ornate sculptures. The structure features a grand archway supported by Corinthian columns, adorned with statues, garlands, and reliefs. The archway leads to an interior space resembling a temple or palace hall. The arched roof bears detailed sculptures and reliefs depicting various symbolic figures. The scene is composed to suggest depth, with architectural elements extending into the background, revealing a larger building or complex. The composition is highly detailed, focusing on symmetry and classical architectural styles.

artworks.title: Triumphal Arch for Friedrich IV
artworks.artist: Christian Engelbrecht and Johann Andreas Pfeffel, after Peter Schubert von Ehrenberg
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts an intricately designed architectural structure with elaborate carvings, sculptures, and an ornate archway. A statue is positioned at the top of the structure, surrounded by additional statues and decorative elements. The horizon line is just below the midpoint of the image, with trees leading towards a distant path. The scene is created using precise etching, with a monochromatic color palette of sepia or browns and grays. Statues, decorative motifs, and trees frame the scene in the foreground, while the path leads towards symmetrically positioned trees and architectural elements in the distance. The sky features softly rendered clouds.

artworks.title: Triumphal Arch for Charles V
artworks.artist: Johann Ulrich Kraus, after Peter Schubert von Ehrenberg
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural structure adorned with intricate sculptures and reliefs. The facade resembles a triumphal arch, embellished with classical statues, columns, and decorative motifs. At the center is a large archway, above which is a pediment supported by Corinthian columns. Various figures, both human and mythical, are positioned within niches and atop the structure. The composition includes shields, draped cloths, and ornate patterns, typical of baroque style architecture.

artworks.title: Frontispiece with Triumphal Arch with Christ and the Apostles
artworks.artist: Johann Ulrich Kraus
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural façade adorned with statues, featuring a grand archway flanked by columns and topped with intricate carvings and sculptures. The statues are arranged symmetrically, depicting figures in flowing robes with inscriptions at their bases. The drawing showcases the textures of stone and the craftsmanship of the architectural elements. Lush foliage and trees are shown in the background, with ornate candelabras and sculptural details in the foreground. The central figure in the archway holds a staff, emphasizing historical grandeur and religious significance.

artworks.title: Vitia hominem monstrosum...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures in an illustrative style. The figure on the left is a hunchbacked man bent over slightly, with one hand reaching forward and the other resting on the woman's sleeve. His facial features are exaggerated with a wide mouth and prominent ears, and he wears a long pointed hat. His attire consists of a long-sleeved garment that appears wrinkled, and he has a sword strapped to his side. The other figure is a woman standing next to him, with a slightly turned posture. She has a tall, intricate hairstyle and a high ruffled collar encircling her neck. Her facial features are also stylized, showing high cheekbones and a pointed nose. She is dressed in a richly textured gown with elaborate sleeves and a fitted bodice, adorned with buttons. Both figures stand on a plain, light-colored background, with Latin text inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Virtui est gratus quoties...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in historic attire from just above the knees upwards. The person on the left is a woman with detailed facial features, wearing a pointed headdress and an elaborate gown with pleated details and a patterned skirt. She has a necklace. The person on the right is a man with distinctive facial features, wearing a hat with a feather and a fur-trimmed cloak. Latin text is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Turpis res desidiosa senectus...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length male figures standing on the ground with a small plant between them. Both figures are turned slightly towards each other. The man on the left has a beard, moustache, and wears a hat with feathers. He is dressed in layered historical clothing and gestures with one hand while the other hand is extended towards the other man. The man on the right has curly hair, a beard, and is dressed in a long robe and cap. Both men are barefoot. The background is plain, and there are formal script words at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Non semper gravibus...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman, standing closely together facing each other. The woman, to the left, has a serene expression and stylized hair with beads or pearls. She wears an elaborate gown and holds a decorative fan in her right hand. The man, to the right, has a beard and mustache, styled hair, a large headdress, and a detailed robe. They stand on a graduated background with plant elements at their feet, with a Latin inscription below them.

artworks.title: Turpe senex miles...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures facing each other. On the left, a woman stands holding a fan in her right hand, partially covering her face. She wears an elegant high-collared dress with intricate curls in her hairstyle. The man on the right leans slightly towards the woman with his hands clasped in front of him. He has distinct facial features, a pointed beard, and short, curly hair. His attire is robe-like with voluminous sleeves. The background is plain and the lower portion of the image contains a cursive caption.

artworks.title: Qui hebetiores animi facultates...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: Two people are depicted standing facing each other. The person on the left is draped in an elaborate garment with a veil and fringe. The person on the right wears a head covering and a patterned robe. Both have some facial features visible, with the person on the right having a beard and curly hair. The person on the left holds a cloth and reaches out with both hands, while the person on the right extends a hand towards them. The background is plain with decorative plants at their feet.

artworks.title: Intempestivis impendere...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing side by side. The person on the left has a beard and curly hair, wearing armor and holding a staff. The person on the right is holding flowers and a basket. Both individuals have unique attire and stand on a ground with plants. The background has a textured pattern, and Latin text is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Efficiunt mores uxoris...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description:
The image depicts two standing figures facing each other. 
The figure on the left is a bearded male wearing a feathered hat and elaborate clothing with a cloak. 
To his left stands a female figure with an intricate updo and elegant robe. 
Both figures gesture with their hands standing on a ground with vegetation and flowers. 
The background is plain, with handwritten text below the figures.

artworks.title: Amoris virus hominem...
artworks.artist: Robert Boissard after Jean-Jacques Boissard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals positioned closely together. The person on the left is standing proudly, gazing into a mirror held in their right hand, with their head turned slightly to the side. This individual has elaborate facial features, including pronounced eyebrows and full lips, as well as curly hair adorned with a prominent headdress or crown featuring points. They are draped in a flowing garment with detailed patterns and a richly decorated hemline. The second individual, standing beside them and leaning slightly forward, has an older appearance with a more weathered face, highlighted by a bushy beard and short hair. This person is wearing long robes that cascade to the ground. The setting includes some simple floral elements at the bottom and a Latin inscription beneath the figures, providing a textual element in an otherwise plain, lightly textured background.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Woman Turning to Foliage
artworks.artist: Jean Lepautre
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative design. The image features a central figure, cherubs, and floral elements. The central figure is depicted from the waist up, with intricate hair and arms that transition into scrolling, leafy branches extending outward. Above the figure is a large, elaborate vase held by two cherubs. The cherubs are positioned around the vase, which is adorned with flowers and foliage. The style is reminiscent of baroque ornamentation, with rich detail and flowing lines creating a sense of movement and grandeur. The design reflects a harmonious and symmetrical composition typical of classical decorative arts.

artworks.title: Fame on a Trophy of Arms
artworks.artist: Jean Lepautre
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 16.2 x 11.5 cm (6 3/8 x 4 1/2 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure with a trumpet surrounded by ornamental elements. The central character appears to be a classical figure. It stands, framed by intricately drawn acanthus leaves and scrolls. The figure is depicted in a dynamic pose, with drapery that clings to the body. The base upon which the figure stands includes various symbolic items and motifs, such as a shield, books, and a lion's mask.
